description: IPython command execution via improper neutralization of special elements in temporary file paths
vuln_code:
import os
def execute_ipython_cmd(cmd_input):
    temp_path = '/tmp/' + cmd_input
    os.system('cat ' + temp_path)
safe_code:
import subprocess
def execute_ipython_cmd(cmd_input):
    temp_path = os.path.basename(cmd_input)
    subprocess.run(['cat', os.path.join('/tmp', temp_path)], shell=False, check=True)
